content.short: Bitget supports over 20 million users in more than 100 countries to buy, sell and trade crypto.
content.description: Bitget, established in 2018 by a team with traditional finance backgrounds, has grown into a leading crypto exchange that serves more than 20 million users across 100+ countries. It enables trading across 550+ coins with competitive fees—0.10% or lower when paying with the Bitget Token—while maintaining a $390 million Protection Fund designed to support a secure and reliable trading environment. This combination of scale, broad availability, and a protected trading framework has drawn more than 650,000 traders to the platform.
